timing: Fresh native process and scratch for every attempt. Includes preparation, decision, exact comparison, cleanup, and fallback. References, imports, model loading and offline training are separate.
scope: Rational kinematic profiles form disjoint groups. Dot positions also change across profiles. Symbolic cases use disjoint target indices within each graph. Known graph structures; no claim of transfer to unseen graphs.
comparison: Same improved native executable and exact basis for all methods. Thus learned/fixed isolates the learned choice from deterministic preprocessing.
uncertainty: Three repetitions per test method. Per-case ranges are descriptive; no confidence-level or universal-speedup claim.
